"''Reroute all power to the energy shield.|Romas Navander and Carlist Rieekan|audio=Navander-Rieekan.flac|}} '''Romas Navander''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was among the [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]] stationed in the control room of [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. In [[3 ABY]], he listened to [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] report his encounter with an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[XJ9-CS14|Viper probe droid]] to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], which prompted the Alliance to begin evacuating Hoth. When Imperial [[Death Squadron|forces]] arrived in the [[Hoth system]], he was the first to inform [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]]. He later announced over Echo Base's speaker system that the [[Quantum Storm|first]] of the rebel [[GR-75 medium transport|transports]] had successfully passed through the Imperial [[blockade]]. ==Biography== ===An Alliance discovered=== {{Dialogue|Organa|An Imperial probe droid.|Solo|It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.|Rieekan|We'd better start the evacuation.|attr=Navander listened to a discussion between Leia Organa, Han Solo, and Carlist Rieekan after the discovery of an Imperial probe droid|audio=Organa-Solo-Rieekan.flac|src=}} [[File:Navander_Full_Costume.png|thumb|left|250px|Navander (center right) was stationed in Echo Base under the command of Carlist Rieekan.]] [[Lieutenant]] Romas Navander{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2019/3/8/in-the-trenches|text=In the Trenches}} was a [[human]] who served as an [[Alliance officer|officer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was among the [[Alliance Military|forces]] that were stationed in the rebel's [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]], where he worked as a [[controller]] in the base's command center. In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]]. Navander rushed with [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]] and a [[commander]] over to a control room terminal where [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was listening to [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] report his encounter with an Imperial [[XJ9-CS14|Viper probe droid]] that he had destroyed near the base. Assuming that the Empire now knew their location, Rieekan ordered that the evacuation of Echo Base begin. ===The Empire arrives=== {{Quote|The first transport is away. The first transport is away.|Romas Navander, during the Battle of Hoth|audio=Navander-Transport.flac|}} [[File:Navander_Button.png|thumb|right|250px|Navander reported the arrival of the Empire to Rieekan.]] During the preparations, Navander remained at his console in the command center, where he was alerted to the arrival of the Imperial [[Death Squadron]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' in [[Sector Four (Hoth system)|Sector Four]] within the [[Hoth system]]. He urgently motioned over Rieekan and informed him of the arrival of the Empire. Rieekan then gave Navander an order to reroute all power to the base's [[Deflector shield|shields]] in order to prevent an [[orbital bombardment]] of Echo Base. Navander then called out to the command center that the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyrant]]'' was approaching. After the Imperials [[blockade]]d Hoth and began landing [[Blizzard Force|ground forces]], the rebels launched the first of their [[GR-75 medium transport]]s, ''[[Quantum Storm]]''.{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Toryn Farr - Communications Officer}} Echo Base's [[V-150 Planet Defender|v-150 ion cannon]] then fired at the Imperial blockade, disabling the the ''Tyrant'' and allowing the [[transport]] to escape unharmed. Navander announced the successful evacuation of the ''Quantum Storm'' over Echo Base's speaker system, prompting cheers from rebels waiting for evacuation. Ultimately, the Alliance successfully evacuated Echo Base, but sustained heavy casualties in doing so. ==Personality and traits== Navander had fair skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, and graying brown [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Navander wore a white [[Clothing|bodysuit]] with a brown, sleeveless, high-collar [[jacket]], and gray [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Romas Navander first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The character was portrayed by [[Burnell Tucker]] in the film and credited only as one of several "Other Officers." Tucker also portrayed [[Wyron Serper]] in the film, and had previously played the character [[Del Goren]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodmemorabilia.com/en/star-wars/burnell-tucker-star-wars-autographed-1996-star-wars-ccg-number-100-bas-authenticated-card-with-best-wishes-inscription/t-24061638+p-342245908180674+z-9-2953284177|text=Burnell Tucker Star Wars Autographed 1996 Star Wars CCG #100 BAS Authenticated Card with "Best Wishes" Inscription|work=[https://www.hollywoodmemorabilia.com/en/ Hollywood Memorabilia]|archivedate=20230617112514}} in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].{{Film|IV}} Navander's scenes in the Echo Base control room were shot on Stage 1 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[March 26]] and [[March 28|28]], [[1979]].''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]'' The speaker announcement of the first transport escaping Hoth was not performed by Tucker, but instead by actor [[Mark Hamill]], who portrayed [[Luke Skywalker]] in the film.{{InsiderCite|119|The Empire Strikes Fact!|The Empire Strikes ''Fact!''}} In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Navander was first identified in "In the Trenches," a [[2019]] article published on the official website of [[Fantasy Flight Games]], announcing the ''[[Rebel Veterans Unit Expansion]]'' for the [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Legion]]''. Romas Navander's name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in [[1996]] on a card in the ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Romas "Lock" Navander}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Romas Navander|imagecat=Images of Romas Navander}} *''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' {{Ab|Battlefront: Twilight Company (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]] *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' Screen Comix]] *{{StoryCite|story=Ion Control|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} *{{GOA|Battle of Hoth (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2019/3/8/in-the-trenches|text=In the Trenches}} {{1stID|Romas Navander}} *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Romas Navander }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Navander, Romas}} [[Category:Alliance Military officers]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
